thread:
anya: quick heads-up — starting commissioning for orbit-9b prototype. need a compact rollout + safeguards checklist for hosted / dedicated / private. planning to run int8 experiments first, then int4 if stable. who can help scope the sequence?

liam: i can. propose staged canary: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 72h with automated checks at each step. rollback if any check fails.

raj: +1 to staged. add smoke checks:
- latency: p50 < 200ms (hosted), p95 < 450ms
- memory: resident < 90% gpu mem
- kv/warmup: prefix cache hit rate > 60% after warmup window
- errors: 5xx rate < 0.1%

taylor: quality thresholds (eval harness):
- instruction-following pass rate drop <= 1.5% relative to baseline
- embedding cosine similarity avg >= 0.985 vs baseline for semantic tasks
- hallucination check: factual hallucination rate not > baseline + 0.5%
- top-k output divergence: KL divergence < 0.02 on benchmark set

anya: good. we should codify automatic triggers:
- safety rollback: any of the above fails at canary step
- emergency rollback: doubled user-facing error rate or latency spike > 2x for 30m
- progressive scale only if metrics stable for 4h at the prior step

liam: fallback chain idea:
1) orbit-9b-quant-int8 (primary)
2) orbit-9b-quant-int8-safe (slower with larger context tuned kernels)
3) sparrow-4b (fallback smaller model)
4) route to dedicated reserved capacity with older model if capacity noise

raj: for private deployments add: KMS integration, no external logging by default, audit logs pushed to customer SIEM. validate HSM keys before traffic.

taylor: quant plan: quick probe run on 1% sampled traffic to measure perf + embed drift. schedule:
- day0: offline quant train + eval on dev prompts
- day1: smoke int8 canary (0.5%) + monitor 8h
- day3: expand to 2% if pass
- week1: int4 experiment in isolated dedicated pool (not hosted)

anya: ops checklist for eng-platform:
- create canary route in routing table with weights
- limit canary QPS to safe quota (e.g., 50 qps)
- setup tracing: per-request token cost + latency tags
- synthetic traffic generator with golden prompts running during canary
- alert hooks to #incidents and oncall pager for rollback triggers

liam: sample rollout config (for reference):
```yaml
deployment: orbit-9b-int8-canary
steps:
  - weight: 0.5%
    duration: 8h
    checks: [latency, errors, quality_eval]
  - weight: 2%
    duration: 16h
    checks: [latency, errors, quality_eval, embed_drift]
  - weight: 10%
    duration: 24h
    checks: [stability_window]
```

raj: rollback command (manual):
```bash
redwoodctl rollout cancel --deployment orbit-9b-int8-canary --reason "quality regression"
redwoodctl traffic set --model sparrow-4b --percent 100
```

deploy-bot: created task ENG-ML-2748: "orbit-9b commissioning — run canary plan & safety checks" assigned to liam, raj (https://tracker.internal/ENG-ML-2748) :white_check_mark:

anya: operational notes:
- for dedicated: we can push int4 experiments in a separate pool to avoid host instability; keep rollback window longer (48h)
- for private: mirror config but require customer sign-off for any fallback that sends traffic outside their VPC

taylor: metrics dashboard to build:
- canary perf: p50/p95 latency, token throughput
- quality: eval pass rate, embed drift, hallucination counter
- cost: tokens/sec, GPU-hours estimate vs baseline

liam: final ask: someone to run a quick dry-run tomorrow afternoon to verify alerts + synthetic generator. i volunteer if raj can validate the eval harness.

raj: i'll validate eval harness and push test vectors by EOD.

anya: perfect — i'll own coordinating rollout and sign-offs. thanks all. :rocket:
